paragraphs: AI: "AI firm ElevenLabs to invest 'hundreds of millions of dollars' in India" (Reuters) leads the coverage. Also notable: "AI may come for your job. It's not the end of the world — it's the start of a new one." (The Hill).

Political: "Paramount merges with Warner Bros., creating Skydance media empire" (Washington Examiner) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Kenya reports first Ebola case amid outbreak brought from Congo" (Washington Examiner).

Economic: "Yellen Says Trump ‘Appalling’ on US Allies, Backs Retaliation" (Bloomberg) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Coalition’s migration plan risks breaching India free trade agreement and damaging economy, advocates warn" (The Guardian).
Financial: "Emmys Leave Their Broadcast Home for Amazon" (The New York Times) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Paramount Closes Its Deal for Warner Bros. Discovery" (The New York Times).

Geopolitical: "Live Updates: Protests Spread Across France as Unions Join Student Demonstrations" (The New York Times) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Why Saudi Arabia’s Last War in Yemen Turned Into a Quagmire" (The New York Times).
